title: Solomon’s Prayer at the Temple
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler with the warm heart who notices others, and tonight Solomon prays for everyone, even strangers: Willow kneels with open arms and prays for a hurt friend and a lonely new boy.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because Willow has a warm heart that notices other people, and Solomon’s prayer reached out to everyone, even strangers far away. In Willow’s world today: her friend Ava fell at recess and went home with a sore arm. That evening Willow kneels by her bed and spreads her arms wide, like Solomon. She prays for Mom and Dad, for Ava’s arm, and for the new boy at school who looked lonely. Just like Solomon, Willow learned that Heavenly Father hears every prayer, and we can pray for others too.
